summary: Burke & Herbert Financial Services Corp. closed a $100 million underwritten offering of 7.00% fixed-to-floating subordinated notes due 2036, priced at 100.00% of par, via a September 28, 2026 underwriting agreement with Keefe, Bruyette & Woods as sole underwriter; the 8-K was filed September 30, 2026. Proceeds plus cash on hand will repay $4.5 million of 6.875% notes due 2028, $18.1 million of 6.00% notes due July 2030, and $20.0 million of 5.00% notes due October 2030. The company may also retire up to $75 million of 3.25% notes due 2031 and redeem $15 million of 2021 preferred stock at $10,000 per share. Watch liability-management execution and any partial redemptions.
